messages:
mae: FYI customer reported a sudden p99 jump to ~12s on /v1/generate for their Dedicated pool (ded-prod-east-7) starting 09:03 UTC. They've escalated to support.
ops-bot: ALERT: ded-prod-east-7 p99_latency > 10s (12.3s) • alloc_saturation=92% • open_incident=INC-4823
jordan: I can see a ton of nodes in the pool stuck at ContainerCreating. kube shows long image download and InitContainers waiting.
jordan: kubectl -n inference get pods | grep ded-prod-east-7
```
inference-attach-abcde   ContainerCreating   0/4     0s
inference-attach-fghij   Init:Downloading     0/4     3m
```
sam: This looks like the model cache init path. Last night we pushed a model rollout that added an extra ~1.1GB artifact to the container image at startup — that will serial-download to /tmp on attach which blocks readiness and delays GPU warmup.
sam: Quick repro (from control host):
```
time curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n' 'https://dedicated.internal/v1/attach?pool=ded-prod-east-7&model=x-large'
# first attach ~11.8s; subsequent ~0.2s (after cache)
```
lina: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- bump pool min capacity to 6 to reduce attach pressure
- enable model-prefetch flag for this pool (loads artifact on node start)
- route heavy customers to hosted fallback for next 30m if SLA critical
who can apply overrides now?
cs-alex: Customer is asking for an ETA. They're threatening to rollback the integration if we can't guarantee <2s p99 in the next hour.
sam: I can apply the autoscaler override and flip model-prefetch. Bumping min capacity now (will take ~5m to spin up), then enable prefetch (rolling restart of nodes; ~10m). Hosted fallback needs routing rule change from traffic team.
mae: Ok do it. Sam — execute and post commands you run. Lina — coordinate with traffic for fallback route. Jordan — capture pod-level timings and upload traces to the ticket.
sam: Running override:
```
# override autoscaler min
infra-cli pools update ded-prod-east-7 --min-instances=6 --reason="emergency: attach latency"
# enable prefetch
infra-cli featureflags set ded-prod-east-7 model_prefetch=true
```
ops-bot: ACTION: autoscaler override applied by sam • new_min=6 • action_id=ACTION-9072
ops-bot: ROLL: featureflag model_prefetch=true applied to ded-prod-east-7 • rollout_id=ROLL-118
jordan: After override I see new nodes entering Ready and Init durations dropping. Pod attach time samples:
```
attach_attempt=1 time=11.9s
attach_attempt=7 time=0.3s
```
mae: Good. Sam, what's ETA to confirm p99 < 2s for the customer?
sam: Expect to see p99 improve within 12–18 minutes as nodes become Ready and cache warms. Full hard fix (avoid downloading artifact on attach) requires artifact pre-staging and changing bootstrap — estimate 3 workdays.
cs-alex: I'll tell the customer we expect improvement in ~15m and offer hosted fallback during the window. Marking as high priority.
lina: I'll open infra ticket for pre-staging and model-serving bootstrap change, link it to this incident.
mae: Assigning owners: sam=remediation, jordan=telemetry, lina=long-term fix, cs-alex=customer comms. Please update INC-4823 with timestamps and actions.
ops-bot: INC-4823 updated: "+autoscaler override +prefetch flag" by sam. Incident status: mitigation_in_progress
mae: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: follow-up doc required on model rollout checklist to prevent attach-time artifacts on first attach.
cs-alex: Customer replied: "observed improvement, thanks — holding off rollback for now." :relieved:
mae: I'll close out after 24h monitoring window if stable.
